verdict.rationale: Plausible exposes a documented HTTP Events API (server-side event/pageview recording) and a Stats API (including a /api/v2/query endpoint returning JSON) that can be scripted or called from CI pipelines without a browser, enabling automated ingestion and reporting. However, there is no CLI, SDK, or explicit CI/automation guide, and probes show no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec for easy machine discovery. missing for 10: dedicated CLI or automation-focused docs, explicit CI examples, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI) for tooling integration.
